semantics.work: dynamic PTX operations, separate from CPU instructions
semantics.memory: requested PTX bytes; unresolved generic addresses remain generic; not cache transactions or HBM traffic
semantics.parallelism: logical launch geometry, per-block maximum lane work, and lane-sequence span with block-barrier joins; no GPU cycle estimate
semantics.spanLimitations: lane instruction order serializes independent instructions; warp-exchange joins and cross-block dependency edges are not modeled
semantics.diagnostics: emulator_* counters describe execution machinery, not GPU barriers; block_barrier_lane_arrivals and collective_lane_arrivals come from PTX
semantics.composition: host and device region work is exclusive; device regions own the innermost annotated lane work; launches[].metrics are inclusive totals
semantics.deviceRegions: lane scopes retain individual invocations and PCVs; warp/block scopes require complete physical membership and identical PCVs; no implicit synchronization; scoped span is not inferred
semantics.annotationOverhead: marker calls and marker bodies are not work; ordinary PTX for PCV expressions and parameter staging is counted; annotations may affect compiler optimization
semantics.time: no latency, occupancy, throughput or hardware calibration is inferred
